paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Business Management Associate role in Payments Operations. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I worked as a consultant at JPMorgan Asset Management after roles at Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. This role's mix of business reviews, governance and dashboard work is close to what I've done, and I'd like to bring it back to the firm in a business as large as Payments.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels and turned large datasets into executive reporting and dashboards for senior leadership. Benchmarking past allocations identified 30% in efficiency gains that guided reinvestment decisions. At Lenovo I owned the mapping and QA on AI-powered dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week of reporting, and I turned variance and trend analysis into clear recommendations for stakeholders across teams.

That maps well to preparing content for Monthly Business Reviews, keeping dashboards current and supporting automation reviews for the Head of Payments Operations. I'm organized, careful with detail and comfortable working across teams on tight timelines. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.
